name: 整果箱装杨桃款
description: 整果箱装、绿白双色海报风长图，环形四向图与星形断面为主线

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF for packshots and info screens; full-bleed fresh green #91C058 panels for poster and radial-diagram screens; straight-corner photo cards outlined by a thin #91C058 keyline on #FFFFFF
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright fresh studio daylight, soft top-front key with gentle fill, clean soft contact shadows, subtle cool daylight quality around 5500K, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte #FFFFFF board, raw jute sack texture #CBB79A and kraft carton #C8A46B, a few smooth white pebbles as props
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family only, short headlines in deep green #2A7C2A with generous letter spacing, labels 10-14pt, no brush or calligraphic lettering
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-stroke line icons in #FFFFFF or #2A7C2A with one small #FFB401 accent, plus octagon seal elements carrying one short label each with a 1.5pt #91C058 outline
styleLock.presentationRules: stable product scale and centered placement across the set; the hero product appears as whole fruit while cross-section and peel close-ups are reserved for dedicated macro shots; all frames and cards keep sharp 90-degree corners
noDrift: no rounded or thick-stroked photo frames
styleLock.lockText: {style_lock} consistent fresh green orchard ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean background #FFFFFF, fresh leaf green #91C058, deep green text #2A7C2A and one golden flesh accent #FFB401; bright fresh studio daylight with a soft top-front key, gentle fill and clean soft contact shadows; one modern geometric sans-serif family for short headlines only; straight-corner photo cards outlined by a thin #91C058 keyline; thin single-stroke line icons and octagon single-label seal elements; clean high-end produce photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and centered placement, every frame composed as one complete balanced layout; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no brush or handwritten lettering, no rounded or thick-stroked photo frames, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼点击，白底整果干净合规
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level with a slight 3/4 turn, two whole fruits standing and one leaning, full silhouettes visible, nothing cropped
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front-top key with soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the fruit
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two whole fruits photographed straight-on at eye level with a slight 3/4 turn, standing upright with one leaning against another, full silhouettes visible and nothing cropped, the fruit group filling 60-70% of the frame at the center with even margins on all sides. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-top key and soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the fruit on the surface. Seamless clean background #FFFFFF, no props and no surface texture. Commercial e-commerce packshot quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges, no colored background tint.

shots.intent: 海报式首屏承接，一秒说清核心卖点
shots.camera: straight-on front view, poster layout, product placed in the lower left, full product visible
shots.lighting: soft even daylight, gentle top light, soft contact shadow
shots.background: clean #FFFFFF framed by a bold #91C058 rectangular border and a thin dashed #91C058 inner keyline
shots.props: two flat palm-leaf silhouettes in #91C058 at opposite corners
shots.textZone: upper center one large headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2A7C2A, right column one short sub-line 「{selling_point_2}」, and three small circular labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce poster cover of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on front view with the product filling 50-60% of the frame, placed in the lower left inside a poster layout. Background #FFFFFF framed by a bold #91C058 rectangular border and a thin dashed #91C058 inner keyline, with two flat #91C058 palm-leaf silhouettes at opposite corners. Soft even daylight with a gentle top light and a soft contact shadow. The upper center carries one large headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2A7C2A, the right column one short sub-line 「{selling_point_2}」 and three small circular labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」, the text column balancing the lower-left product into one complete poster composition. Negative: no brush calligraphy, no dense body text, no store badges, no extra claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 放大常见踩雷：果肉发软、风味寡淡
shots.camera: matched split-screen, two identical front-on panels with the same framing and crop
shots.lighting: left panel flat harsh overhead light; right panel soft fresh top-front light
shots.textZone: one short label per panel 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2A7C2A
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two matched panels with identical front-on framing and crop, the fruit filling 50-60% of each panel. Left panel: a dull, limp, wrinkled piece of fruit under flat harsh overhead light, no packaging and no origin of any kind, conveying staleness and weak flavor. Right panel: {product} fresh with a taut glossy surface under soft top-front light. Background #FFFFFF on both panels, each panel carrying one short label 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」 in #2A7C2A above the fruit, the two panels reading as one mirrored comparison. Negative: no fabricated data or statistics, no comparison numbers, no distorted or deformed fruit, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no mismatched framing between panels.

shots.intent: 用环形四向图集中讲清核心生长卖点，信息一眼可读
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, product centered inside a large circular medallion
shots.lighting: even flat infographic lighting with a soft top light on the fruit, no harsh shadow
shots.background: full-bleed fresh green #91C058 panel with one large clean #FFFFFF circular medallion in the center
shots.props: four thin #FFFFFF radial lines with small #FFFFFF sun-ray icons pointing north, south, east and west
shots.textZone: one headline line above the circle 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF, four short radial labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic explaining the growing strengths of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Full-bleed fresh green #91C058 background with one large clean #FFFFFF circular medallion in the center, the product photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle filling 50-60% of the medallion. Four thin #FFFFFF radial lines end in small #FFFFFF sun-ray icons at north, south, east and west, each carrying one short label 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 in #FFFFFF, and one headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF sits above the circle, the medallion and its radials forming one balanced diagram. Even flat infographic lighting with a soft top light on the fruit. Negative: no invented facts, no certification badges, no fabricated numbers, no origin claims, no dense body text, no mixed icon weights, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 代入枝头清晨的鲜活场景，强化新鲜印象
shots.camera: photographed from a low angle looking upward into the leafy canopy, medium shot
shots.lighting: backlit early-morning sunlight at 5500K filtering through the leaves, soft rim light on the fruit, gentle haze
shots.background: deep canopy greens around #2A7C2A-toned bokeh with one bright sky gap #FFFFFF
shots.props: a few wet leaves and one thin branch, no man-made objects
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} still hanging on the branch in a leafy orchard setting. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low angle looking upward into the canopy at a medium shot, the fruit cluster filling 40-50% of the frame with the surrounding foliage completing the composition. Backlit early-morning sunlight at 5500K filtering through the leaves, soft rim light on the fruit and a gentle haze. Deep canopy greens around #2A7C2A-toned bokeh with one bright sky gap #FFFFFF. Props: a few wet leaves and one thin branch, no man-made objects. Negative: no visible people, no hands, no farm signage, no location or origin markers, no duplicated fruit clusters, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用果皮微距证明成熟度与油亮质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro at a low 30-degree side angle, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp, tight on the ridged peel
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing the waxy sheen and the ridge line
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Very close macro at a low 30-degree side angle, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp, tight on the ridged peel and its fine speckling, the detail filling 55-60% of the frame with minimal margins because the texture is the whole point. Raking side light from the right reveals the waxy sheen along the ridge line. Soft out-of-focus background #FFFFFF. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking surface, no added wax drips, no artificial water droplets, no props, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 用断面微距证明果肉饱满多汁，全套最强食欲镜头
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle, one thick cross-section slice centered in macro framing
shots.lighting: soft top light with a gentle side fill so the flesh glows, thin soft contact shadow under the slice
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro, top-down 90-degree overhead view of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. One thick cross-section slice centered in the frame filling 55-60% of the frame with minimal margins because the star-shaped flesh is the whole point, showing the fruit's natural cross-section outline, translucent juicy flesh and its small seed pattern. Soft top light with a gentle side fill so the flesh glows, a thin soft contact shadow under the slice. Clean background #FFFFFF. Negative: no blurry subject, no fabricated texture, no removed seeds, no props, no hands, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 把名称、规格、储存等参数收成一张信息图，消除规格疑虑
shots.camera: front-on flat layout, circular product medallion on the left, spec list column on the right
shots.lighting: even flat studio light, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: clean #FFFFFF with a thin #91C058 keyline framing the layout
shots.props: one circular crop of the product inside a thin #91C058 ring; four straight-corner spec rows in the right column
shots.textZone: right column: four short spec labels 「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」 in #2A7C2A with short #91C058 underlines
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce spec infographic for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Front-on flat layout on a clean #FFFFFF background with a thin #91C058 keyline framing the whole card. A circular crop of the product sits on the left inside a thin #91C058 ring, and the right column carries four straight-corner spec rows with short labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 in #2A7C2A, each with a short #91C058 underline, the medallion and spec rows together filling 60-70% of the frame as one balanced spec card. Even flat studio light, no dramatic shadow. Negative: no filled-in numbers, no fabricated weight, date or yield figures, no certification marks, no origin claims, no dense body text, no tiny unreadable text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 满箱开箱展示分量与包装，降低收货预期风险
shots.camera: photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down into an open carton
shots.lighting: soft even daylight from the upper left, soft contact shadows inside the box
shots.background: open kraft carton #C8A46B lined with folded kraft paper over a matte #FFFFFF board
shots.props: a raw jute sack #CBB79A, folded kraft paper, a few smooth white pebbles
shots.textZone: one short trust label 「{callout_1}」 in #2A7C2A and one octagon seal element carrying 「{callout_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen, a full-box unboxing arrangement of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down into an open kraft carton #C8A46B lined with folded kraft paper on a matte #FFFFFF board, with a raw jute sack #CBB79A beside it and a few smooth white pebbles as props, the fruit layer neatly packed and fully visible, the contents filling 45-55% of the frame. Soft even daylight from the upper left with soft contact shadows inside the box. One short trust label 「{callout_1}」 in #2A7C2A sits beside the carton, and one octagon seal element carrying 「{callout_2}」 with a 1.5pt #91C058 outline anchors the upper corner, completing the composed unboxing tableau. shots.intent: 绿底收口，给出行动入口完成转化

shots.lighting: soft studio light with a gentle top key and a soft contact shadow
shots.textZone: left side headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF; right side one solid CTA button in #FFFFFF with label 「{callout_1}」 in #2A7C2A

Product shown at a slight 3/4 front angle on the left side of the frame under soft studio light with a gentle top key and a soft contact shadow, filling 50-60% of the frame. Full-bleed fresh green background #91C058. The left side carries one headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF; the right side carries one solid CTA button in #FFFFFF with the action label 「{callout_1}」 in #2A7C2A, the button and headline locking the composition into one balanced closing frame. provenance.notes: 源图 6 屏（第 6 屏为绿色色块与店铺会员二维码的延续切片），按行业惯例补足到 10 个分镜。已剥离：店铺会员二维码与入口、原毛笔书法标题与原文案、原商品信息栏文字（品名/规格/营养/储存的原始表述与数值）、产地与生态果园类表述、所有具体数值与资质类暗示、原独特排版；图内中文一律改为 「」+ {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 占位，产品一律以 {product} 占位。仅保留绿白双色系统 + 直角细绿描边照片卡 + 八角单字徽章 + 环形四向图 + 绿框海报首屏的视觉语法。
